notes: Ports upstream v1.4.2: the session list now quietly refreshes when the window regains focus (tray restore, taskbar click, or a second launch), instead of only at startup or on the refresh button, so a window left in the tray no longer shows a stale list. Parsed sessions are now cached per file by size and modification time, so a refresh only re-reads transcripts that actually changed. Also fixes a false 100%-limit-used flash on cold start: before the first real usage measurement arrives (a few seconds), the usage display fell back to scanning your most recent session transcript for a rate-limit error with no staleness check, so a session that had ended on an unresolved rate-limit line -- even days earlier -- showed as 100% used until the real measurement landed. Now uses the same 1-hour staleness cutoff the desktop buddy's own animation logic already relied on. Also carries forward all Linux-only fixes from v1.4.1.1-1.4.1.3 (notification icon/name, window icon, X11/Wayland launch safety, autostart validation, update-dialog translation, Clawdmeter animation-mirroring).
